vLLM's block-FP8 kernel choice on this GPU: MarlinFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel.
Measured peaks: {"fp8_tflops": 367.5, "fp8_flop_per_clk_sm": 1024.03, "bf16_tflops": 183.012, "dram_read_gbps": 956.607}

+q = including the per-token-group activation quantization kernel (vLLM's CUDA one); fused = bf16 activations quantized inside the GEMM (M <= 256 only).
linear = blockfp8.linear, what the vLLM plugin runs: fused, or blockfp8's own quantization kernel + GEMM, per the plan table (linear runs = which).
vs Triton (tuned) = Triton time / blockfp8 time (GEMM only); vs Marlin = Marlin time / blockfp8.linear time (quantization included).
SM clock during the runs (nvidia-smi, 1 s samples): median 2790 MHz, min 2520, max 2805.
